# Chasing Strength

> > Kettlebell training programs and online courses by Geoff Neupert, specializing in strength building, fat loss, and fitness for men over 40.

Chasing Strength offers systematic kettlebell training programs including THE GIANT, SWING HARD!, and Kettlebell HARD, alongside comprehensive online courses like THE BIG 6 and Kettlebell STRONG!. The site emphasizes minimalist training approaches, injury prevention, and specialized programming for busy adults and those over 40.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Training
- Geoff Neupert
- THE GIANT Program
- Clean and Press
- Strength Training for Over 40
- Fat Loss Programs
- Muscle Building
- THE BIG 6 Course
- Systematic Core Training
- SWING HARD!
- Injury Prevention
- Minimalist Training
- Double Kettlebell Exercises
- Kettlebell HARD
- RMF (Rapid Muscle & Fat Loss)

## Training Programs

- [*TRAINING PROGRAMS & WORKOUTS](https://go.chasingstrength.com/training-programs-workouts): Main catalog of strength programs: THE GIANT, SWING HARD!, Kettlebell W.O.D.
- [THE GIANT-3](https://go.chasingstrength.com/the-giantb6): THE GIANT program sales page featuring Clean + Press and R.V.A. Programming
- [Kettlebell HARD](https://chasingstrength.com/kettlebells/hard): Hardcore kettlebell workout program by Geoff Neupert for fat loss & strength
- [Rebuilt After 40](https://go.chasingstrength.com/rebuilt-after-40): 90-minute weekly program for men over 40 targeting fat loss & muscle building
- [Inevitable Strength](https://go.chasingstrength.com/inevitable-strength): 4-phase kettlebell cycle for over-40s addressing injuries and progression

## Online Courses

- [*ONLINE COURSES](https://go.chasingstrength.com/online-courses): Kettlebell courses including THE BIG 6, Kettlebell STRONG!, and RMF
- [Systematic Core Training For Kettlebells](https://go.chasingstrength.com/sctfkb): Core training program to strengthen lifts and prevent kettlebell injuries
- [Systematic Core Training For Kettlebells (Sales Page)](https://cart.chasingstrength.com/systematic-core-special): Sales page for Systematic Core Training using SSP Model for kettlebells

## Exercise Technique Guides

- [The Double Kettlebell Clean And Press](https://chasingstrength.com/videos/double-kettlebell-clean-and-press.html): Step-by-step tutorial for double kettlebell clean and press technique
- [The Double Kettlebell Clean And Push Press](https://chasingstrength.com/videos/double-kettlebell-clean-and-push-press.html): Tutorial guide for double kettlebell clean and push press movement
